kate: Starting a blue->green gradual shift for eu-west3. Plan: 0->20->50->100 over ~18m. Change window open. Notifying oncall @sre-oncall. Release notes link: https://go/release/2026-03-eu3

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] job queued id=ts-1768601234. Steps every 3m. Health checks: p95, 5xx, auth-error-rate.

marta: Router change landed: cookie `rb_v3` set for green, ttl=10m. I updated `router-eu-west3.cfg` rev r88.

sre-oncall: Watch criteria: abort if p95 > 800ms OR 5xx > 0.5% for 3m. I'm on watch.

deploy-bot: progress: 0% -> 20% (step1). Health: OK.

lucas: Running quick synthetic sweep to check tail latencies. No anomalies so far.

kate: saw a tiny spike of 429s from a partner IP block at 20%; checking if that's client-side throttling.

sre-oncall: p95=210ms, 5xx=0.01%, 429s brief spike 0.2% -> back to baseline. No abort.

deploy-bot: progress: 20% -> 50%.

marta: CDN warm invalidation scheduled post-50% to avoid cache thrash.

lucas: All error trackers clean. Proceed to 100% after 5m validation.

kate: Emergency rollback snippet saved in ops notes if needed:
`routerctl set-weight router-eu-west3 green 0 && routerctl set-weight router-eu-west3 blue 100`

deploy-bot: progress: 50% -> 100% complete. status=done.

sre-oncall: Final watch 30m. Metrics stable p95=230ms, 5xx=0.00%.

marta: Tagging release rel/2026-03-eu3 and updating notes with a short postmortem about the 429 spike.

kate: DONE :shipit: Closing thread. Cheers! :tada:
